subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public persisted cron/protocol/CLI/UI/plugin SDK status for yielded-parent handoff in this PR, or should the branch be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The code path is plausibly the right shared lifecycle direction, but the PR changes public status/API contracts and user-visible delivery timing, which automation cannot approve without maintainer product and upgrade intent.

options.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
options.body: Ask for a conflict refresh, redacted Discord status/progress proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the public `deferred` status plus SDK/hook additions before merge.

options.title: Split The Public Surface
options.body: Keep the internal yielded-parent bugfix pieces but split the public cron status and SDK/hook expansion into a separate maintainer-owned contract PR.

options.title: Accept The Contract Risk
options.body: Maintainers may merge after source review on existing cron proof, but that accepts unproven Discord behavior and downstream compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Ask for a conflict refresh, redacted Discord status/progress proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the public `deferred` status plus SDK/hook additions before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron protocol/status work makes steipete the best available routing candidate for the public status and upgrade-contract choice.
